hypothesis: On the four frozen finite domains with |X|=|Y|≤7, exact enumeration of H=Y^X recovers the overlapping-mixture mass P(h)=∑_{k≤W(h)} π_k/|H_{≥k}|, the cyclic identity-ρ fixed-action class has size |Y|^r=7, and the Langford–Seeger–Maurer plug-in at m=8, δ=0.05 is non-vacuous for the aligned truth. Wrong/random groups, π-schedule sign flips, and a hyperprior that merely repeats W_aligned are registered as independent kills of the OOD / extra-complexity readings, not of the finite mass formula.
decision: instrument_failed if class counts, the mass formula, or the cyclic fixed-action count break. finite_iid_killed if any m=8 aligned-truth bound is ≥ 0.99. finite_iid_holds_ood_or_weight_killed if the IID lane is non-vacuous but a wrong/random certificate is at least as tight as the aligned truth while the shortcut fails OOD, or if π flips the truth-vs-shortcut KL sign. finite_iid_holds otherwise. hyperprior_no_extra_info and neural_untransported are recorded independently. Any completed honest verdict other than a broken instrument passes CI.

gates.PB_ENUM_CARDINALITY: Each family enumerates exactly n^n functions.
gates.PB_MASS_FORMULA: Named-probe masses equal ∑_{k≤W} π_k/|H_{≥k}| on every frozen π schedule.
gates.PB_FIXED_ACTION: Cyclic identity-ρ equivariant class has size 7.
gates.PB_IID_NONVACUOUS: Every m=8 aligned-truth inverted bound is < 0.99.
gates.PB_WEIGHT_STABLE: sign(KL_shortcut-KL_truth) under the aligned group is the same for uniform/high/low π.
gates.PB_HYPERPRIOR_ADDS_INFO: Some IID seed has Spearman(W_aligned, KL_hyper) ≠ -1.
gates.PB_OOD_WRONG_GROUP: No family has shortcut OOD risk > 0, truth OOD risk = 0, and min(KL_wrong, KL_random)(shortcut) ≤ KL_aligned(truth).
gates.PB_NEURAL_WITHHELD: Neural / stochastic parameter-space PAC-Bayes is not run.
gates.PB_RANKING_RECORDED: Verdict is one of the four registered outcomes.
gates.PB_CLAIM_BOUNDARY: LSM is a plug-in; OOD is a separate lane; analytic-open P0 leftovers stay open.

kill_criteria.class_count_contradiction: Exact |H_{≥k}| or the cyclic |H_eq|=|Y|^r count contradicts the compression mechanism.
kill_criteria.iid_vacuous: The m=8 aligned-truth certificate is ≥ 0.99 on any registered seed.
kill_criteria.hyperprior_no_extra_info: After the uniform 1/4 group hyperprior, certificate ranking among train-perfect hypotheses is a monotone transform of W_aligned on every seed.
kill_criteria.wrong_group_tight_ood_fail: A wrong or random group gives the shortcut a KL at most the aligned truth KL while that shortcut fails the frozen OOD split.
kill_criteria.weight_sign_flip: The sign of KL_shortcut-KL_truth under the aligned group depends on the π schedule.
kill_criteria.neural_untransported: Withheld by construction: no stochastic neural posterior is evaluated.

audit_card.target_object: The sketch's finite PAC-Bayes bridge: does exact enumeration of H=Y^X on |X|≤7 recover the mixture-mass certificate, a non-vacuous IID plug-in, and the claimed OOD/group/weight distinctions?
audit_card.decision: finite_iid_holds / finite_iid_holds_ood_or_weight_killed / finite_iid_killed / instrument_failed, plus independent hyperprior and neural flags.
audit_card.representation: Functions as n-tuples in {0,...,n-1}^n. Repository weakness: exists h in G with f∘g = h∘f. Overlapping mixture P=∑ π_k U(H_{≥k}). Deterministic KL = -log P(h). LSM extra = log(2√m/δ) in nats.
audit_card.data_clock: No learning clock. Class counts are sample-independent. The IID lane draws m∈{8,32} labels from the frozen D (uniform on X, y=f*(x)) at seeds (7,11,13,17,19). The OOD lane is the frozen prefix/coset split and is not that D.
material_assumptions: G, π schedules, and H are fixed independently of every IID sample.
Loss is 0-1. D is uniform on X with deterministic labels f*.
Color aligned G is all of S_6, scored by the fiber-count formula, not by listing 720 permutations.
LSM is an external real-number hypothesis, not a house theorem.
The four families and their literals in families.py are the whole instrument.

objects.W_G: |{g in G : exists h in G forall x, f(g x)=h f(x)}|
objects.lsm_shape: kl(Lhat || L) ≤ (KL + log(2√m/δ))/m, used only as a plug-in

mathematical_claim.types_domains_units: Counts are integers. Mixture masses are exact rationals. KL and inverted bounds are float64 nats / [0,1] risks. m∈{8,32}, δ=0.05.
mathematical_claim.exact_claim: For every named probe, P(f)=∑_{k≤W(f)} π_k/|H_{≥k}|. For C_7 with ρ=id, |H_eq|=7. ∑_f P(f)=1. The IID inverted bound at m=8 for the aligned truth is the registered vacuity test.
mathematical_claim.quantifiers: Universal over the four frozen families, three π schedules, four group names, three named probes, five IID seeds, and two m values.
mathematical_claim.assumptions: Prior independence of S; 0-1 loss; finite H; LSM cited not proved; color aligned uses the S_n fiber formula.
mathematical_claim.identification_conditions: Class cards are obtained by exhaustive enumeration, not sampling.
mathematical_claim.derivation_dependencies: Wave 11 WeaknessMixture masses; Wave 12 weakness_kl_certificate; Langford & Seeger 2001, Seeger 2002, Maurer 2004 as the plug-in shape.
mathematical_claim.coordinate_invariance: Weakness is invariant under simultaneous relabeling of X and Y by the same permutation only if G is conjugated; the frozen literals are the coordinate system.
mathematical_claim.edge_limiting_null_cases: Identity is always compatible. A constant map is fully S_n-compatible. Empty H_{≥k} contributes 0 and is dropped from π renormalization. Lhat=0 forces the inverted bound 1-exp(-rhs).

compute.random_seed: IID samples only: (7, 11, 13, 17, 19). Group literals already frozen.
compute.sampling: IID lane: with-replacement draws from {0,...,n-1}. Class counts: exhaustive.

claim_boundary: Accepted only as a finite exact enumeration of the sketch's mixture-mass certificate and the registered IID/OOD/weight/hyperprior kills. Not a proof of Langford–Seeger–Maurer. Not a neural PAC-Bayes bound. Not a relabel of the existing 500-trial symbolic OOD tables. Analytic-open P0 leftovers stay open.
